sections.label: Global and domestic growth challenges
sections.summary: Singapore's growth faces global inflation, weak demand, structural shifts and tighter manpower, land and carbon constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In the near-term, persistent global inflation and a weak global demand outlook will weigh on Singapore’s growth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will also need to respond to major structural shifts, including an increasingly fragmented geopolitical landscape, accelerating disruptions from emerging technologies, and the global momentum on climate change.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Domestically, we will need to pursue economic growth amidst tighter manpower, land and carbon constraints.

sections.label: Singapore Economy 2030 and trade expansion
sections.summary: MTI will pursue the Singapore Economy 2030 vision, Industry Transformation Maps 2025, and expand and diversify trade despite protectionism.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MTI will press on with our journey towards the Singapore Economy 2030 vision to achieve longer-term, sustainable growth, by expanding our trade, capturing opportunities in the manufacturing and services sectors, and uplifting our enterprises and workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will also implement the plans under the Industry Transformation Maps 2025 to strengthen our industries and workforce capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Even as other countries adopt more protectionist measures, Singapore will expand and diversify our trading activities and markets, capture more re-exports and transhipments, and embed Singapore deeper into global supply chains.

sections.label: Supply chain resilience coordination
sections.summary: MTI will coordinate government-wide supply chain resilience efforts to secure critical supplies for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MTI will coordinate supply chain resilience efforts across government to secure critical supplies for Singapore.

sections.label: Lowering barriers and helping enterprises
sections.summary: MTI will streamline regulations, improve service delivery, and help promising enterprises internationalise into Singapore Global Enterprises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will lower barriers to entry by streamlining regulations and improving service delivery.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will, through a bespoke approach, help promising enterprises internationalise and grow into future Singapore Global Enterprises.
